authors: Thomas KN, Gower DJ, Bell RC, Fujita MK, Schott RK, Streicher JW
title: Diversity and evolution of amphibian pupil shapes (data set: Amphibian pupil data, 1293 records, CSV 366,853 bytes, with ReadMe and references files)
journal: Biological Journal of the Linnean Society 137: 434-449 (data: Natural History Museum Data Portal)
why: Pupil shape per amphibian species (1293 records), open under ODC-By; the portal's table view says 'not available at the moment', the datastore API is robots-disallowed for the fetch tool and the download link has no target.

title: Archelosaurian color vision, parietal eye loss, and the crocodylian nocturnal bottleneck: supplementary table S1

authors: Futahashi R, Kawahara-Miki R, Kinoshita M, Yoshitake K, Yajima S, Arikawa K, Fukatsu T
title: Extraordinary diversity of visual opsin genes in dragonflies: Table S1 and Dataset S1
journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 112(11): E1247-E1256
why: The main text gives opsin gene totals for 6 of the 12 species; Fig. 6B and Dataset S1 hold the full set of 12 species (SW and LW counts, one per species), which the PMC text does not carry.
get: download Dataset S1 and Table S1 from the PNAS supplementary page in a browser (open access); the species counts are drawn in Fig. 6B
